title: Tseitin formulas need size 2^Omega(treewidth) on planar and minor-free graphs
subject: Size lower bounds for resolution and algebraic refutations of Tseitin formulas beyond expanders
conclusion: If every edge outside a bounded set lies on a short cycle with short detours avoiding it, Tseitin formulas need size 2^Omega(treewidth) in resolution and in polynomial calculus with or without twin variables over characteristic other than 2. This covers plane graphs with short faces and d-dimensional grids, and through wall topological minors every graph excluding a fixed minor, planar graphs included (resolution and PCR).
